prose: Google is rolling out a new wave of Connected Apps for Gemini, letting users manage projects, design creative assets and plan workouts without switching tabs. Apps can be connected in Gemini settings or brought into a chat by typing an @ mention or asking directly. The September 23 announcement is by Gemini App group product manager Mai Lowe.
highlights: New wave of Connected Apps rolling out to Gemini.
Manage projects, design assets and plan workouts inside Gemini.
Connect via Gemini settings or @ mention apps in chat.
Announced by GPM Mai Lowe on September 23.
